title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 — The First
Banner investigates legends of another scientist, dead 30 years, who underwent a Hulk-type metamorphosis; Banner risks his own cure to rid the world of his violent predecessor.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S5 E2 — Two Godmothers
Three escaped prisoners, one of them pregnant, take Banner hostage; guests Penny Peyser, Kathleen Nolan.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S2 — White Line Warriors
Michael investigates burglaries in a resort town.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S2 E16 — Race for Life
Michael and KITT must find a fugitive, the only potential bone-marrow donor, to save a child.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S2 E17 — Speed Demons
Michael and KITT must stop a killer at the Foundation's motorcycle race; guest Lydia Cornell.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E2 — The Wedworth Townsend Act
An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E3 — Mascot
Gage promises to care for an injured woman's dog; the paramedics save five lives including a diabetic and a man trapped on a ledge.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E4 — Botulism
An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E5 — Cook's Tour
DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E2 — Recipe for Heavy Bread
The team members aid their former POW cook (Mako), an unwitting participant in drug smuggling; guest Marjoe Gortner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E3 — The Only Church in Town
Face's former girlfriend (Markie Post), now a nun, hires the team to rescue nuns and orphans held in an Ecuadorean monastery.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E4 — Bad Time on the Border
A lost Mexican girl leads B.A. to a smuggling ring responsible for illegally transporting aliens across the border.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E5 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
An Indian boy wants to stop a wealthy rancher (Morgan Woodward) rustling mustangs on an Arizona reservation.
